reviews.title: Works with Ryzen 5 series out of the box
reviews.comment: This board is great for the price. My 5600x and team group ddr4 3200 cl16 vengeance ram 2x16gb (xmp) worked perfect out of the box. Supports. Resizeable Bar, PBO 2 , undervolting, overclocking etc. The bios has a ton of options. The heatsinks are heavy, surprisingly heavy. Comes with backplate. The only negatives are the lack of PWM fan headers (1) + CPU PWM header (there's also 1 3pin fan header but no fan control using it). And, no USB 3.0 support.

reviews.title: Awesome socket AM4 motherboard; low price, good performance.
reviews.comment: This time around is my 2nd build in 2023 using this ASRock B450M. So far, with 4th gen Ryzen 5 4600g, and 5th gen Ryzen 7 5700g, this board seems to perform pretty well. It arrived safely packed inside an Amazon box. My only concern was the seal on the motherboards box itself was broken when I got it. Thought that was weird for a new product, usually open boxes get some type of discount. Doesn't appear to be anything missing and the motherboard is functioning fine, but still curious about the broken seal in the end. Definitely a solid option for those looking for components on a very limited budget. Both of my builds with this board were <$700.
